summary: Normalize scalar multiplication results with dup_strip and dmp_strip so EX coefficients that simplify to zero during clear_denoms produce canonical dense polynomials. Added regression for zero and partially vanishing polynomials with 1, 2, and 3 generators and convert=False/True, including is_zero, expression, terms_gcd, and primitive behavior. Confirmed new regression fails before fix. Public bin/test run for test_densearith.py, test_densetools.py, and test_polytools.py passed all 241 tests (exit 0). Only subsequent edit wrapped a test line for formatting. Final diff inspected.
